description: List workspaces that can use an integration, with their limits. Use this to audit access or confirm per-workspace cost and rate settings. Returns total plus workspace ids, names, enabled state, usage limits, and rate limits. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.
